instance_host.title: Instance Host
instance_host.description: The address of your instance, without https://

options.tooltip: The address you use to reach Medallia — for example `mycompany.medallia.com` (leave out `https://`). Your Medallia administrator can confirm it if you're unsure.

Your company (account) name, as given by your administrator — usually your organization's short name. It is entered separately because some instances spell it differently in the API address, so it can't be filled in automatically.

api_host.title: API Host
api_host.description: The API address for your instance

options.tooltip: The address that serves your data — for example `mycompany.apis.medallia.com`. It is different from the Instance Host above, and test/sandbox instances use a different one, so enter exactly the address your administrator gives you.

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: The Client ID from your API credentials

options.tooltip: Part of the API credentials your Medallia administrator creates for you (sometimes called an app or integration key).

#client_secret.title: Client Secret
#client_secret.description: The Client Secret that pairs with the Client ID

options.tooltip: The secret that goes with the Client ID — treat it like a password. Your Medallia administrator issues it, and it is stored encrypted.
